item.text: {"item_id":"youtube:jLndwlduyzc","version_id":"2f5aa4c182fc8c438e529036a6c11142dda4ce503db1c62572482e77c85ede20","decision":"accept","reason":"This is a fresh, dated commercial CAD-practitioner perspective relevant to agentic 3D: it shows how query-based references and face/surface operations can make parametric models more resilient to upstream edits. Onshape demonstrates a specific check at 00:01:02, where adding a slot upstream leaves the draft operation updating without errors; that supports only the shown model-edit case, not a general reliability claim. The vendor also says direct face references and query variables reduce later repair work (00:02:05–00:02:47), but broader productivity or manufacturability benefits would require disclosed task sets and independent tests.","piece_ids":["03"]}
